title: Rolling from tummy onto the back by about 6 months
summary: Most children roll from tummy to back by about 6 months.
body: One Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 6-month movement line is rolls from tummy to back. The direction named is tummy to back only. The opposite direction is not printed on that list. The page files the line with what most children do by six months. A newborn who rolls later is outside what this sentence classifies. Sheets written in other countries need not use six months. The reverse direction stays unlisted on the six-month movement page.
